innodb_thread_concurrency.description: Defines the maximum number of threads permitted inside of InnoDB.

innodb_doublewrite.description: When enabled (the default), InnoDB stores all data twice, first to the doublewrite buffer, then to the actual data files.

innodb_random_read_ahead.description: Enables the random read-ahead technique for optimizing InnoDB I/O.

innodb_buffer_pool_size.description: The size in bytes of the buffer pool, the memory area where InnoDB caches table and index data.

innodb_max_dirty_pages_pct_lwm.description: Defines a low water mark representing the percentage of dirty pages at which preflushing is enabled to control the dirty page ratio.

innodb_purge_threads.description: The number of background threads devoted to the InnoDB purge operation.

innodb_compression_failure_threshold_pct.description: Defines the compression failure rate threshold for a table, as a percentage, at which point MySQL begins adding padding within compressed pages to avoid expensive compression failures.

innodb_change_buffering.description: Whether InnoDB performs change buffering, an optimization that delays write operations to secondary indexes so that the I/O operations can be performed sequentially.

innodb_online_alter_log_max_size.description: Specifies an upper limit in bytes on the size of the temporary log files used during online DDL operations for InnoDB tables.

innodb_purge_batch_size.description: Defines the number of undo log pages that purge parses and processes in one batch from the history list.

innodb_lru_scan_depth.description: A parameter that influences the algorithms and heuristics for the flush operation for the InnoDB buffer pool.

innodb_max_dirty_pages_pct.description: InnoDB tries to flush data from the buffer pool so that the percentage of dirty pages does not exceed this value.

innodb_write_io_threads.description: The number of I/O threads for write operations in InnoDB.

innodb_stats_transient_sample_pages.description: The number of index pages to sample when estimating cardinality and other statistics for an indexed column, such as those calculated by ANALYZE TABLE .

innodb_spin_wait_delay.description: The maximum delay between polls for a spin lock.

innodb_compression_pad_pct_max.description: Specifies the maximum percentage that can be reserved as free space within each compressed page, allowing room to reorganize the data and modification log within the page when a compressed table or index is updated and the data might be recompressed.

innodb_read_ahead_threshold.description: Controls the sensitivity of linear read-ahead that InnoDB uses to prefetch pages into the buffer pool.

innodb_concurrency_tickets.description: Determines the number of threads that can enter InnoDB concurrently.

innodb_log_write_ahead_size.description: Defines the write-ahead block size for the redo log, in bytes.

innodb_change_buffer_max_size.description: Maximum size for the InnoDB change buffer, as a percentage of the total size of the buffer pool.

innodb_autoextend_increment.description: The increment size (in megabytes) for extending the size of an auto-extending InnoDB system tablespace file when it becomes full.

innodb_sort_buffer_size.description: This variable defines: For related information, see Section 14.

innodb_adaptive_max_sleep_delay.description: Permits InnoDB to automatically adjust the value of innodb_thread_sleep_delay up or down according to the current workload.

innodb_ft_total_cache_size.description: The total memory allocated, in bytes, for the InnoDB full-text search index cache for all tables.

innodb_flush_log_at_timeout.description: Write and flush the logs every N seconds.

innodb_ft_sort_pll_degree.description: Number of threads used in parallel to index and tokenize text in an InnoDB FULLTEXT index when building a search index.

innodb_ft_min_token_size.description: Minimum length of words that are stored in an InnoDB FULLTEXT index.

innodb_read_io_threads.description: The number of I/O threads for read operations in InnoDB.

innodb_table_locks.description: If autocommit = 0 , InnoDB honors LOCK TABLES ; MySQL does not return from LOCK TABLES .

innodb_ft_result_cache_limit.description: The InnoDB full-text search query result cache limit (defined in bytes) per full-text search query or per thread.

innodb_purge_rseg_truncate_frequency.description: Defines the frequency with which the purge system frees rollback segments in terms of the number of times that purge is invoked.

innodb_thread_sleep_delay.description: Defines how long InnoDB threads sleep before joining the InnoDB queue, in microseconds.

innodb_adaptive_flushing_lwm.description: Defines the low water mark representing percentage of redo log capacity at which adaptive flushing is enabled.

innodb_io_capacity_max.description: If flushing activity falls behind, InnoDB can flush more aggressively, at a higher rate of I/O operations per second (IOPS) than defined by the innodb_io_capacity variable.

innodb_max_purge_lag.description: Defines the desired maximum purge lag.

innodb_log_file_size.description: The size in bytes of each log file in a log group.

innodb_flush_neighbors.description: Specifies whether flushing a page from the InnoDB buffer pool also flushes other dirty pages in the same extent.

innodb_fill_factor.description: InnoDB performs a bulk load when creating or rebuilding indexes.

innodb_compression_level.description: Specifies the level of zlib compression to use for InnoDB compressed tables and indexes.

innodb_old_blocks_time.description: Non-zero values protect against the buffer pool being filled by data that is referenced only for a brief period, such as during a full table scan.

innodb_replication_delay.description: The replication thread delay in milliseconds on a replica server if innodb_thread_concurrency is reached.

innodb_page_cleaners.description: The number of page cleaner threads that flush dirty pages from buffer pool instances.

innodb_sync_spin_loops.description: The number of times a thread waits for an InnoDB mutex to be freed before the thread is suspended.

innodb_adaptive_hash_index_parts.description: Partitions the adaptive hash index search system.

innodb_sync_array_size.description: Defines the size of the mutex/lock wait array.

innodb_api_disable_rowlock.description: Use this option to disable row locks when InnoDB memcached performs DML operations.

innodb_ft_cache_size.description: The memory allocated, in bytes, for the InnoDB FULLTEXT search index cache, which holds a parsed document in memory while creating an InnoDB FULLTEXT index.

innodb_cmp_per_index_enabled.description: Enables per-index compression-related statistics in the Information Schema INNODB_CMP_PER_INDEX table.

innodb_use_native_aio.description: Specifies whether to use the Linux asynchronous I/O subsystem.

innodb_max_purge_lag_delay.description: Specifies the maximum delay in microseconds for the delay imposed when the innodb_max_purge_lag threshold is exceeded.

innodb_log_buffer_size.description: The size in bytes of the buffer that InnoDB uses to write to the log files on disk.

innodb_api_enable_mdl.description: Locks the table used by the InnoDB memcached plugin, so that it cannot be dropped or altered by DDL through the SQL interface.

innodb_file_per_table.description: When innodb_file_per_table is enabled, tables are created in file-per-table tablespaces by default.

innodb_ft_num_word_optimize.description: Number of words to process during each OPTIMIZE TABLE operation on an InnoDB FULLTEXT index.

innodb_optimize_fulltext_only.description: Changes the way OPTIMIZE TABLE operates on InnoDB tables.

innodb_log_files_in_group.description: The number of log files in the log group.

innodb_max_undo_log_size.description: Defines a threshold size for undo tablespaces.

innodb_ft_max_token_size.description: Maximum character length of words that are stored in an InnoDB FULLTEXT index.

innodb_stats_auto_recalc.description: Causes InnoDB to automatically recalculate persistent statistics after the data in a table is changed substantially.

innodb_open_files.description: Specifies the maximum number of files that InnoDB can have open at one time.

innodb_stats_include_delete_marked.description: By default, InnoDB reads uncommitted data when calculating statistics.

innodb_api_bk_commit_interval.description: How often to auto-commit idle connections that use the InnoDB memcached interface, in seconds.

innodb_commit_concurrency.description: The number of threads that can commit at the same time.

innodb_stats_on_metadata.description: This option only applies when optimizer statistics are configured to be non-persistent.

innodb_io_capacity.description: The innodb_io_capacity variable defines the number of I/O operations per second (IOPS) available to InnoDB background tasks, such as flushing pages from the buffer pool and merging data from the change buffer.

innodb_log_compressed_pages.description: Specifies whether images of re-compressed pages are written to the redo log.

innodb_undo_log_truncate.description: When enabled, undo tablespaces that exceed the threshold value defined by innodb_max_undo_log_size are marked for truncation.

innodb_flush_log_at_trx_commit.description: Controls the balance between strict ACID compliance for commit operations and higher performance that is possible when commit-related I/O operations are rearranged and done in batches.

innodb_adaptive_flushing.description: Specifies whether to dynamically adjust the rate of flushing dirty pages in the InnoDB buffer pool based on the workload.

innodb_ft_enable_diag_print.description: Whether to enable additional full-text search (FTS) diagnostic output.

innodb_deadlock_detect.description: This option is used to disable deadlock detection.

innodb_print_all_deadlocks.description: When this option is enabled, information about all deadlocks in InnoDB user transactions is recorded in the mysqld error log.

innodb_flushing_avg_loops.description: Number of iterations for which InnoDB keeps the previously calculated snapshot of the flushing state, controlling how quickly adaptive flushing responds to changing workloads.

innodb_rollback_segments.description: Defines the number of rollback segments used by InnoDB for transactions that generate undo records.

innodb_default_row_format.description: The innodb_default_row_format option defines the default row format for InnoDB tables and user-created temporary tables.

innodb_stats_persistent.description: Specifies whether InnoDB index statistics are persisted to disk.

innodb_disable_sort_file_cache.description: Disables the operating system file system cache for merge-sort temporary files.

innodb_api_enable_binlog.description: Lets you use the InnoDB memcached plugin with the MySQL binary log.

innodb_rollback_on_timeout.description: InnoDB rolls back only the last statement on a transaction timeout by default.

innodb_ft_enable_stopword.description: Specifies that a set of stopwords is associated with an InnoDB FULLTEXT index at the time the index is created.

innodb_flush_sync.description: The innodb_flush_sync variable, which is enabled by default, causes the innodb_io_capacity setting to be ignored during bursts of I/O activity that occur at checkpoints.

innodb_stats_method.description: How the server treats NULL values when collecting statistics about the distribution of index values for InnoDB tables.

innodb_strict_mode.description: When innodb_strict_mode is enabled, InnoDB returns errors rather than warnings when checking for invalid or incompatible table options.
